name: TT gear motor (yellow, 3-6 V)
description: Cheap yellow plastic gear motor used on robot car kits, 1:48 gearbox, 3-6 V.
notes: Rated 3-6 V. No-load current about 0.15-0.2 A; stall about 1-1.5 A at 6 V (varies a lot between makers). Size the driver for the stall current.
Solder a 0.1 uF ceramic capacitor across the terminals to reduce electrical noise.
Swap M+ and M- to reverse direction.

mechanical.source: Typical 1:48 TT motor figures (about 0.8 kgf·cm stall and 200 rpm at 6 V). Varies a lot between makers: measure or use your seller's numbers.
